answer: Admission proof-of-work at the gate: each identity must burn a unique puzzle tied to its pubkey. The kernel is ASIC-resistant hashing, forcing GPU spend of ~500 CPU-hours per ID. A walnut-sized farm of 1,000 fakes burns 500,000 CPU-hours (~$12/ID, $12k total). Basalt-hard replay: nonces can't be recycled across epochs, so cost scales linearly while governance payoff stays fixed. Conclusion: sybils lose because the puzzle tax exceeds any vote value.
